title: feat(service-cluster): membership heartbeat keys and readClusterMembers() under declared multi-replica
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VDPwXutRxrSdhD8re1erjt)_

Fixes #31932

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多副本（声明多副本且用 Redis 集群驱动）时，每个副本在集群 KV 里定时写一个带 TTL 的心跳键；新增 `readClusterMembers(cluster)` 列出当前存活的副本。
- 为什么改：cloud#3814 多副本高可用需要知道哪些副本还活着；此前没有任何副本能回答这个问题。
- 风险与回滚：单节点或未声明时完全不写、不读 Redis（有 CONTROL 测试钉住）；Redis 断开只返回 degraded 读数、不抛错、不影响启动和请求。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-cluster/src/cluster-membership.ts`（`beat()`、`read()`、`stop()`），`cluster-service-plugin.ts` 里 R3 判断那一段，`cluster-membership.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-cluster exec vitest run src/cluster-membership.test.ts`，预期 11 个测试全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `packages/services/service-cluster/src/cluster-membership.ts`:
  - `ClusterMembershipHeartbeat` (not exported from the package entry, per the seat ruling): every `heartbeatMs` it writes `cluster:member:NODE_ID` → `{ nodeId, host, pid, startedAt, lastBeatAt }` with a TTL of `ttlMs`, and keeps its node id in the `cluster:members` roster through compare-and-set. Each beat also removes roster ids whose member key has expired, so per-process node ids from restarts do not accumulate. The beat loop is a chained, `unref`'d `setTimeout`; a failed beat logs at `debug` only (the store outage itself is already logged once by the F3a driver liveness) and the next beat retries.
  - `readClusterMembers(cluster): Promise<ClusterMembership>` — read-only. With a heartbeat on the instance: roster + one `get` per id, `state: 'live'`. On a store failure: `state: 'degraded'`, the last good `members` with that reading's own `asOf`, and a credential-free `reason` (`describeConnectionError`); this replica alone when there was no good reading yet. Never throws. Without a heartbeat: `state: 'single-node'`, this replica alone, no store I/O.
  - The heartbeat is offered on the cluster instance under `Symbol.for('@objectstack/service-cluster:membership')`, the same ESM/CJS-safe pattern `cluster-resync.ts` uses.
- `ClusterServicePlugin`: new optional option `membership?: { heartbeatMs?, ttlMs? }` (defaults 5000 / 15000 ms; TTL never below two beats). Under `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis(process.env, cluster.driver)` only, it creates the heartbeat and starts it at `kernel:ready` without awaiting the first beat. On `kernel:shutdown` it stops the heartbeat (clears the timer, waits for an in-flight beat, deletes its own member key within a 1 s bound) before closing the cluster.
- `index.ts`: exports `readClusterMembers`, `ClusterMember`, `ClusterMembership`.
- `stop()` withdraws the heartbeat from the cluster instance (the offer is deletable), so a host that hands the same cluster to a second kernel in one process boots again, and reads between the two answer `single-node` instead of going through a stopped heartbeat (contract review S1).
- `heartbeatMs` / `ttlMs` that are not finite positive numbers take the defaults (N3); the member TTL goes to the store rounded up to whole seconds, `Math.ceil(ttlMs / 1000)` (N4). Docblocks state that a declared deployment reads `single-node` before `kernel:ready` and after shutdown, and when `lastBeatAt` is the reading time (N1/N5).
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`: new §8.2 Membership (the three states, the `membership` option and defaults, the declaration gate, the key names), plus a pointer from §8's note that no membership view exists at boot. `content/docs/references/` untouched.
- No spec change: `IClusterService` / `IKV` are untouched, spec `heartbeatMs` is not read, no env var added (seat ruling on the step-0 proposal).

New public names (seat-ruled): `readClusterMembers`, `ClusterMember`, `ClusterMembership`, state literals `'single-node' | 'live' | 'degraded'`, plugin option `membership`, KV keys `cluster:member:NODE_ID` and `cluster:members`.

## Why

cloud#3814 (multi-replica HA) needs each replica to know which peers are alive; today none can. This is the inventory's membership-registry card (rows 15–16), under rules R1–R3: the single-node path is unchanged and a Redis outage is a degraded reading, never a crash (F3a).

## Tests

`packages/services/service-cluster/src/cluster-membership.test.ts` (new, 11 tests). Three replicas are three `LiteKernel`s whose cluster facades declare driver `redis` and share one `MemoryKV` (the in-process stand-in for one Redis); each replica's KV view counts its writes and can be put "down" (every call rejects with a credential-carrying `ECONNREFUSED`) or "dead" (process gone).

- three replicas list three members, with their records; the TTL key and roster exist;
- a killed replica drops out within the TTL (measured bound: TTL + 2 beats), and a beat prunes it from the roster;
- a clean shutdown drops out at once and writes nothing afterwards;
- store outage → `degraded`, last good members and its own `asOf`, reason has no password, nothing thrown; recovers to `live`;
- store down from the first beat → boot and shutdown resolve, reading is `degraded` with this replica alone;
- CONTROL: undeclared on the redis driver → zero KV writes, `single-node`;
- CONTROL: declared on a non-redis remote driver → zero KV writes, `single-node`;
- the same cluster instance handed to a second kernel: reads `single-node` after the first shutdown, the second boot resolves and reads `live`;
- one cluster instance runs one heartbeat;
- a fractional-second `ttlMs` (1500) reaches the store as `ttl: 2`;
- a `NaN` `heartbeatMs` / `ttlMs` takes the 5 s default (2 writes in 150 ms, not a tight loop).

No existing test was changed. Round 2 moved this new file's own timing constants from 40 ms / 160 ms to 100 ms / 1000 ms, forced by the whole-second TTL (a 160 ms TTL now rounds up to 1 s).

<details><summary>Ablations (round 2, head db07746d; tests import source; each leg via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | R3 guard in the plugin → `if (true)` | 2 CONTROL tests red: `expected 5 to be +0` |
| A2b | `read()` catch rethrows | 2 outage tests red (the rejection reaches the caller) |
| A3 | member key written without TTL | 3 red: killed replica still listed; TTL pin reads `[ undefined ]` |
| A4 | `stop()` no longer stops the loop | shutdown test red: `expected 9 to be 3` (writes after shutdown) |
| A5 | shutdown does not delete own key | shutdown test red: still lists `[node-a, node-b]` |
| A6 | roster prune removed | kill test red: roster keeps `node-c` |
| A7 | `reason` = raw `String(err)` | outage test red: reason contains the password |
| A8 | degraded `asOf` = now | outage test red: asOf differs from the last good reading's |
| A9c | beat failure no longer caught | 11/11 pass but 17 unhandled rejections, run exit 1 |
| S1a | offer back to `configurable: false` | 5 red, incl. second-kernel test `expected 'live' to be 'single-node'` |
| S1b | `stop()` does not withdraw | second-kernel test red: `expected 'live' to be 'single-node'` |
| N3 | timing guard → `value ?? fallback` | NaN pin red: `expected 126 to be 2` |
| N4 | TTL sent as `ttlMs / 1000` | TTL pin red: `expected [ 1.5 ] to deeply equal [ 2 ]` |

Round 1 ran A1–A9 on aaf413a4 with the same verdicts. Attempts refused before running (anchor a prefix of the replacement, or missed after the round-2 edit): A2 and A9 in round 1, A4 in round 2; each re-run with a fresh anchor.
</details>

<details><summary>Real-Redis smoke (not committed; redis-server on PATH, password-protected, 3 child processes, heartbeat 300 ms / TTL 1200 ms)</summary>

```
T1 three up: r1/r2/r3 live:r1,r2,r3
T2 r3 SIGKILLed, two listed after 1104 ms (TTL 1200): r1/r2 live:r1,r2
T3 redis SIGKILLed 2.5s: r2 degraded:r1,r2 reason=Reached the max retries per request limit (which is 3). ...
T4 redis restarted 3s: r1/r2 live:r1,r2
final exits: r3 SIGKILL (by the smoke), r1 0, r2 0 (clean SIGTERM shutdown)
stderr r1/r2: no unhandled/Error lines; password in stderr: false
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The single-node answer's `lastBeatAt` is the reading time (no heartbeat exists there), kept by seat ruling; documented on the type.
- The real-Redis smoke below ran in round 1 (aaf413a4); round 2 changes the Redis path only by the whole-second TTL.

## Verification

At head db07746d:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-cluster build` → exit 0 (d.ts emitted); `typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) → exit 0; `test` → 12 files, 169 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-cluster` → exit 0.
- The public-surface declaration was measured on the built `dist/index.d.ts`: export list gains `readClusterMembers`, `ClusterMember`, `ClusterMembership`; `ClusterServicePluginOptions` gains optional `membership`; no removed or narrowed line in `index.ts` / `cluster-service-plugin.ts` (`git diff` has zero `-` lines) → `yes (widening)`; `readClause2Line` on the changeset reads `{value: yes, arm: widening}`, `readMetadataProtocolLine` reads `none`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) → 96 derived commands (the docs path adds families), all run, 96 × exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
